overall: MARGINAL-to-POOR overall: five grounds are GOOD (Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Panlaitan), the east side is VERY POOR and the Culion side is POOR
limiterDetail: The main limiter is east wind: Nangalao 21–24 kt (gusts to 30), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 20–25 kt, Barangonan 19–22 kt, Ciron 17–22 kt, and Linapacan 16–18 kt, all for the next 24h. Second limiter is current: 0.9–1.4 kt now at Culion, Decabaitot, Alava, Binudac and Barangonan, rising to 1.5–2.4 kt tonight. Rain is light, 0.0–0.6 mm/h (Barangonan peaks 0.6).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning matching Calamian / MIMAROPA in the recent feed (a distant tropical cyclone alert is listed). See the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the afternoon digest (Mon 2:20 PM)
items: The east side shut harder and the supply outlook is a little softer for Mon 16, but Sat 14 improved. Fishing right now is 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 5 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 8 POOR / 1 VERY POOR): Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Barangonan dropped from POOR to VERY POOR as east wind built to 21–23 kt (gusts 28–29), joining Nangalao and Ciron. Culion, Linapacan, Alava and Binudac stay POOR.

Regional wind for Wed 11 and Thu 12 is now 15 kt, gusts 22 (was 16 kt, g22–23): basically unchanged, so Thu 12 and Fri 13 stay soft. Sat 14 is calmer (6.9 kt vs 8.8 before). Mon 16 now rebuilds to 12 kt, gusts 18, so it is no longer “better”. The strong current pulse (1.5–2.4 kt) is unchanged, now about 11 PM–5 AM tonight (Tue night) at Decabaitot, Alava, Barangonan, Culion and Binudac. PAGASA: no warning for Palawan. Shortage detector ELEVATED Tue–Mon; surge OFF.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF. The shortage detector is ELEVATED for Tue–Mon (guide only). Tightening risk is high for Thu 12–Fri 13 arrivals after two windy days (Wed–Thu). Lean on Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo for supply.

bestWindow.headline: Today about 6–11 AM at the west and south grounds; best hour about 10–11 AM
details: Decabobo, Tara and Turda: about 10–11 AM (wind 3.0–3.6 kt, current 0.2–0.6 kt); Tara and Turda current rises to 1.0 kt near 6 PM. Panlaitan and Maglalambay: about 8–9 AM (5.5 kt, current 0.0–0.2). Coron and Galoc: about 6–7 AM (5–6 kt, current 0.0–0.1), workable all day (winds peak ~10 kt at noon).

Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (19–25 kt, gusts to 30), and avoid Decabaitot, Alava, Barangonan, Culion and Binudac about 11 PM–5 AM (current 1.5–2.4 kt). Wind rises at Tara, Decabobo and Turda toward dawn Wednesday (to ~14 kt).
